outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single representative fluorescence images for each of three transfection conditions with no quantification. The caption does not state that the experiment was repeated, nor how many times, nor what would constitute a replicate (e.g., independent transfections, dishes, or experiments).

Bar graphs quantifying JC-1 and anti-HMGB1 signal report n=20 with significance stars, so the number of replicates is given. However, neither the panel nor the caption specifies what the n=20 units are (e.g., individual cells, images, or fields), so the type of replicate is not reported.

The Western blot in panel C is shown as a single representative image with no quantification, and neither the panel nor the caption states how many times the blot was performed or on what kind of replicate (e.g., independent transfections/lysates).
